description.en: A sphere cuts through a cube: a compact introduction to solid modeling.
description.zh: 用球体切开方体，从最简单的布尔运算开始。

description.en: Repeated curved strips form an open woven container.
description.zh: 重复排列的曲面条带构成镂空编织容器。

description.en: A complete table with six pockets, cushions, a wooden frame and four legs.
description.zh: 包含六个球袋、台呢、木框和四条桌腿的完整台球桌。

description.en: A hollow cup with a curved body and a loop handle.
description.zh: 中空杯体与环形把手组成的咖啡杯。

description.en: A thin curved bowl, rolled rim and wooden handle.
description.zh: 薄壁圆底锅体、环形锅沿与木柄。

description.en: A skillet with pouring lips, a long handle and a hanging hole.
description.zh: 带浇注口、长柄和挂孔的铸铁煎锅。

description.en: A multi-part rover with wheels, a chassis and scientific instruments.
description.zh: 由车身、轮组和科学仪器构成的月球车装配。

description.en: A microscope assembly with a base, stage, support and optical tube.
description.zh: 组合底座、立柱、载物台与镜筒的显微镜。

description.en: An open cockpit, curved fairings, rounded tires and hollow exhaust pipes.
description.zh: 开放座舱、曲面车罩、圆肩轮胎与中空排气管组成的卡丁车。

description.en: A bamboo frame with interlaced cord, curved rails and detailed wrapping.
description.zh: 竹制框架配合立体交织纸绳、弯曲横撑和周边绕绳。

description.en: A curved top rail, seven back spindles, a sculpted seat and tapered legs.
description.zh: 弯曲顶梁、七根靠背圆杆、曲面座板和锥形椅腿。

description.en: A small mechanical part built from sketches and feature operations.
description.zh: 由草图与特征操作构成的油标尺零件。

description.en: A stepped flange with a center bore and six evenly spaced bolt holes.
description.zh: 带中心通孔和六个均布螺栓孔的阶梯法兰盘。

description.en: A bearing support with a mounting base and machined openings.
description.zh: 由安装底座、座体和开孔构成的轴承座。

description.en: A stepped shaft modeled with solid features and cuts.
description.zh: 通过实体特征与切削构造的阶梯轴。

description.en: A mechanical enclosure with an internal cavity and detailed features.
description.zh: 具有内部腔体和细节特征的机械壳体。

description.en: A display assembly with twin flywheels, a power piston and a displacer.
description.zh: 包含双飞轮、动力活塞和移气活塞的低温差斯特林展示机。

name.zh: 横置石英管斯特林展示机

description.en: A quartz hot-end tube, cooling fins, linkages, a belt and a braided wick.
description.zh: 横置石英热端管、散热片、连杆、皮带和编织灯芯。

description.en: A 32-blade fan assembly with code-lofted airfoils and detailed root attachments.
description.zh: 用代码放样叶型的 32 叶片风扇组件，包含叶根及固定件。

description.en: A four-wheel utility vehicle with curved bodywork, a cargo platform and tubular rails.
description.zh: 带曲面车壳、后货台和管式护栏的运输四轮 ATV。

description.en: A continuous transparent shell, upholstered seat and black four-leg support.
description.zh: 连续透明厚壳、软垫、黑色承托与四条外撇椅腿。
